description: Header file defining classes, structs, and dependencies for the Open Fronthaul User-Plane downlink data flow implementation, including configuration, dependencies, trace name management, and the main data flow class.

classes.name: ofh_uplane_trace_names<Enabled>
classes.description: Manages trace names for OFH tracing when enabled.

classes.name: ofh_uplane_trace_names<false>
classes.description: Specialization for when OFH event tracing is disabled; provides empty trace names.

classes.name: data_flow_uplane_downlink_data_impl
classes.description: Main class implementing the downlink data flow, managing message enqueueing, dependencies, and metrics.

methods.name: enqueue_section_type_1_message
methods.description: Enqueues a section 1 message for the downlink data flow.

methods.name: get_operation_controller
methods.description: Returns reference to the operation controller.

methods.name: enqueue_section_type_1_message_symbol_burst
methods.description: Enqueues a burst of symbols in a section 1 message.

methods.name: enqueue_section_type_1_message_symbol
methods.description: Enqueues a single symbol message with given parameters.

methods.name: get_metrics_collector
methods.description: Returns the metrics collector for encoding metrics.
